ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface coverage with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white/grey) pixel distribution, primarily concentrated in localized mottling and stochastic specks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Diffuse, high-contrast grey/white mottling cluster located on the upper-lateral region of the left lobe; dense stochastic distribution of discrete white pixel points (specks) scattered across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and moderate bounding-box penetration depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits a lower frequency of serrations but features a prominent, high-amplitude macro-notch indentation approximately 15% inward from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the leading edges, sweeping posteriorly into sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization located on the distal tips of both lobes, with a higher spatial density and larger cluster area on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional grey linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, including a primary diagonal abrasion oriented from the upper-medial toward the lower-lateral quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular tissue deficit (macro-notch) on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal region; localized calcified barnacle clusters on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
